guidebook.role.description.brin:puppetee:
The Puppeteer is a killer who works with the dead.

Use the ability on a corpse to turn it into a puppet; the corpse disappears.
Crafting cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.

Open your inventory to pick a stored puppet, summon it in front of you
and possess it. Your real body stays behind, motionless, and the ability
becomes "return to body".
A puppet carries a knife and a crowbar and can use instinct.
It is scrapped after {skill_duration_seconds} seconds and starts giving off
particles once it has been active for 30 seconds.
A destroyed puppet leaves no corpse, and a used puppet is gone for good.

Returning glows you for 10 seconds and starts a {return_cooldown_seconds} second cooldown.
If the puppet is killed instead of dismissed, you are yanked back and also
suffer 15 seconds of slowness.
If your real body dies, the puppet dies with it instantly.

The shop sells a knife ({knife_price}) and Self-Destruct ({self_destruct_price}).
With Self-Destruct bought, the next puppet you control explodes in a 3x3x3
area centred on itself when it dies.
guidebook.role.description.brin:stunt_do:
The Stunt Double is accustomed to being pushed onto the stage.

Open the inventory, choose a living player, and
take on their appearance.

While transformed, fatal damage dealt to that player
kills you in their place.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
Mimic duration: {skill_duration_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:medium:
The Medium is permanently connected to the dead,
leaving them unable to communicate with the living.

Only the dead can hear your voice.
guidebook.role.description.brin:eavesdro:
The Eavesdropper can monitor all chat messages
regardless of distance.

Spend {skill_cost} coins to pull one non-Medium player
into a temporary voice channel with you.
The channel lasts {skill_duration_seconds} seconds,
and neither player can leave it voluntarily.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:watchman:
The Survival Expert can see traps, mines, and players who are pinned or carrying a bomb.

Aim at a target and press the ability key
to spend {skill_cost} coins and free them or defuse the bomb.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:beast_tr:
The Trapper deploys deadly traps.

Press the ability key and spend {skill_cost} coins to deploy one.
Only you, your teammates and the Survival Expert can see the trap.
A trapped player remains immobilized until death.

You may have up to {trap_limit} traps at once.
Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:nightmar:
The Nightmare plants fear in sleepers.

Aim at a highlighted player to plant fear;
planted players cannot kill you.

From the backpack, choose a living player
to replace their task with Sleep.
Cooldown: {forced_sleep_task_cooldown_seconds} seconds,
independent of planting.

Spread fear until only you and the fearful remain alive.
guidebook.role.description.brin:illusion:
The Illusionist can create phantom doubles of themselves.

Press the ability key once to create two doubles.
While they exist, press the key again to cycle between
the east double, west double, and your body.
While controlling a double, your body remains in place.
If your body dies, every double disappears immediately.

You can use your doubles to kill.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
Clone duration: {skill_duration_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:sniper:
The Sniper possesses exceptional long-range killing ability.

Press the ability key to enter aiming mode.
While aiming, the Sniper focuses completely;
press the ability key again to take the shot.
Your bullet is penetrating and lethal.

You glow for everyone to see while aiming and
for {glow_seconds} seconds after firing.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
The kill-refresh count is configured in the config file;
set it to -1 to disable refreshes.
guidebook.role.description.brin:berserke:
The Berserker is the embodiment of destruction.

Purchase Psycho Mode to become invincible until the match ends.

Instinct is available during Psycho Mode.

Civilian attacks cannot kill you.

Kill them all!
guidebook.role.description.brin:archivis:
The Archivist can identify corpses forged by the Bodymaker, and mortician disguises.

Aiming at a corpse reveals whether its record is forged.

Spend {skill_cost} coins to prevent the Cleaner from dissolving
or the Necromancer from reviving that corpse.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds
guidebook.role.description.brin:boneharv:
The Boneharvester buries the traces of evil.

Corpses from kills made during the passive ability
appear after 20 seconds.

Buy the Bone Knife for {bone_knife_price} coins.
Use it on a corpse to remove its bones and gain one shield layer.
Processed corpses cannot be used by the Cleaner or Necromancer.

Bone Knife cooldown: {bone_knife_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
item.brinswathe.bone_knife.used: You removed the bones and gained one shield layer.
guidebook.role.description.brin:compensa:
The Compensator repays blood with blood.

When a Civilian tries to kill you, you take their place
and survive as a new Civilian.

When a Killer tries to kill you, you take their place
and survive as a new Killer.

When someone of an unknown team tries to kill you,
both of you die together.

No active ability.
guidebook.role.description.brin:gambler:
The Gambler wagers with his life.

Spend {skill_cost} coins to bet on a player.
While your target remains alive, you may change your bet.

Your eyes will remain fixed on your bet target forever.

If your target dies after the wager,
you bite down on the poison capsule in your mouth.

If your target survives for 6 minutes,
you win whether you are alive or dead.

Bet everything you have.
guidebook.role.description.brin:penitent:
At the start of the round, the Penitent receives a guilty role
from the Civilian team and must personally kill its designated
player.
A new target is selected if that player dies.

A correct kill grants a shield; a wrong kill poisons you.
You start with {starting_shield_layers} shield layer(s).

Identity Hint: {identity_hint_price} coins.
Antidote: {antidote_price} coins.
Kill 2 targets with 6–8 players or 3 with more than 8.
Finish the targets for an independent victory;
otherwise follow the Killers' result.
guidebook.role.description.brin:terroris:
The Terrorist turns death into a final weapon.

When you are shot, a grenade-like explosion with a range of
{explosion_range} blocks erupts around you.

If that explosion actually kills at least {explosion_survival_kills}
other players, you survive the gunshot.

No active ability. No Instinct. No shop.
guidebook.role.description.brin:zhangshi:
Zhangshi hunts with speed and poison.

The free ability boosts speed for {skill_duration_seconds} seconds
with a {skill_cooldown_seconds}-second cooldown.

Xuezi costs {xuezi_price} coins and has a
{xuezi_cooldown_seconds}-second purchase cooldown.
Eating it grants infinite speed, poison, and
{xuezi_shield_layers} shield layers.
Kill before the poison takes you to clear it;
speed lasts 5 more seconds, then shields disappear.
guidebook.role.description.brin:stalker:
Once the Stalker's gaze locks on, it never lets go.

Right-click a living player with an empty hand to start stalking them.
Their face appears on your screen and moves in real time,
pointing out where they are even through walls and carriages;
when they are off-screen the icon sticks to the screen edge.

Stalking has no time limit - it lasts until the target dies
or you pick somebody else.
Switching targets has a {skill_cooldown_seconds} second cooldown.

The stalked player is never told.
The Stalker has no shop.
message.brinswathe.stalker.tracking: Now stalking %s; switching targets has a %ss cooldown.
message.brinswathe.stalker.tracking_unli: Now stalking %s. Your Unlimited modifier removes the cooldown (configured: %ss).
guidebook.role.description.brin:avenger:
The Avenger walks unarmed: no shop, no instinct.

But witness a player die with your own eyes - the death happens inside
your field of view with nothing blocking the line - and you are instantly
handed a revolver for {skill_duration_seconds} seconds, along with
{instinct_seconds} seconds of automatic instinct that highlights every living
player in one single colour: positions only, no identities.

When the {skill_duration_seconds} seconds are up the revolver vanishes.
Witnessing another kill restarts the clock.

Outside that window you cannot hold a gun at all: guns on the ground refuse
to be picked up, any gun grabbed during the window vanishes with it,
and no firearm of yours ever drops when you die.
guidebook.role.description.brin:cowboy:
The Cowboy settles grudges the old way: at high noon.

Open your inventory and pick any living player - anyone, killers included -
to spend {skill_cost} coins and call a showdown. Once per round.

Both duelists are carried to a duelling ground far from the train and set
back to back; everyone else watches as a spectator.
During the {duel_countdown_seconds} second countdown both screens stay dark;
the moment it ends, each duelist is handed a revolver - draw!

Every shield layer on both duelists is stripped before the duel.
If nobody has fallen after {duel_timeout_seconds} seconds, both duelists
are executed.

When the duel resolves the survivor's revolver is confiscated and everyone
returns to where they stood before the showdown.

guidebook.role.description.brin:morticia:
Nobody knows what a corpse should look like better than the Mortician.

Open your inventory, pick any other player, living or dead, and drop
where you stand as their corpse. You turn completely invisible and only a body wearing that
player's skin is left behind.

The disguise has no time limit; lie there as long as you like.
It breaks the instant you take a step, swing, or use an item.

The {skill_cooldown_seconds} second cooldown only starts once the disguise
breaks, so a long ambush never costs you anything.

Knives, bullets and explosions still kill you while you are disguised.
When you die the fake body vanishes and your real corpse takes its place.
The fake body cannot be bagged, dissolved, deboned, sealed or puppeted,
but an Archivist looking at it will find that it has no record.

Your shop is the ordinary killer shop.
guidebook.role.description.brin:bomber:
The Bomber trades the blade for explosives.

The shop only sells grenades ({grenade_price}) and bombs ({bomb_price});
no knife, no revolver, no Psycho Mode. You may carry one bomb at a time,
and restocking takes {bomb_purchase_cooldown_seconds} seconds.

While you hold a bomb, nobody else can see what is in your hand.
Right click the ground to bury it as a mine, or right click a player
to strap it onto them.

Only you, your teammates and the Survival Expert can see a mine, and
neither the killer team nor the Survival Expert sets one off. Whoever steps on it is pinned in place and
dies the moment they move; the blast only kills that one player. They cannot
free themselves and must wait for the Survival Expert.

A strapped bomb goes off after {bomb_fuse_seconds} seconds, and its carrier
is warned with {bomb_warning_seconds} seconds left. From then on the bomb
beeps for the carrier alone, faster and faster as the end approaches.
A carrier can right click another player with an empty hand to pass the bomb
on; the fuse keeps running.
The blast kills every player inside a
{bomb_explosion_size}x{bomb_explosion_size}x{bomb_explosion_size} cube around
the carrier, the carrier included.
The Survival Expert can see who is carrying a bomb and defuse it.
